    • SnackMachine

      public SnackMachine(int capacity, int cost)
      Constructs a new snack machine with specified capacity and cost.
      Parameters:
      capacity - the maximum amount of crisp packets the machine can hold at any time.
      cost - the cost of each individual packet.

    • buyPack

      public PackOfCrisps buyPack(String flavour)
      Attempts to purchase a pack of the specified flavour. Fails if: there was insufficient payment or there aren't any packs of the specified flavour.
      Parameters:
      flavour - the flavour you wish to buy.
      Returns:
      the purchased pack if it is successful, otherwise null.

      public void describe()
      Outputs the current state of the machine expressed as a string. E.g: "The snack machine has 15 packets of crisps left and has taken 12 pennies in payment.
